index.heroHeadline: I turn complex problems into simple, clear interfaces.
index.heroSupport: Want to talk faith, code, or coffee in Brasília? Reach out.
index.intro5: Outside of work I play drums, skate, train with my wife, and get lost in games, books, and nerdy rabbit holes.
index.intro6: I sometimes write about what I'm learning
index.purpose: Sharing what I know is part of the job. That's why I offer free mentorships for people starting out in tech.
index.journey1: I started in 2019 and have worked in front-end ever since — Angular, React, Vue.js, and TypeScript — on usable interfaces and apps that scale.
index.journey2: I went from intern to tech lead. I like mentoring and passing on what I've learned.
index.projectP4n: 1:1 mentorships between tech beginners and experienced professionals.
index.projectGuardadin: A personal finance app to track spending with more clarity.
index.projectMinhaChurch: Software for churches to manage members, schedules, and announcements.
index.job0Description: Led the front-end team, scaled the platform from scratch, shipped a reusable component library (NPM), and improved delivery workflows. Stack: Vue.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Pinia, TanStack Query.
index.job1Description: Shipped features and fixed production issues with React.js and Node.js. Refactored endpoints and worked with PMs and designers.
index.job2Description: Built interactive UIs with React.js. Worked with QA and design, optimized rendering, and supported sprints.
index.job3Description: Integrated front-end modules into a microservices architecture. Scalable UI with React and Next.js.
index.job4Description: Built enterprise front-end solutions in React.js within cross-functional agile teams.
index.job5Description: Shipped product features, fixed UI bugs, and supported UX and onboarding improvements.
index.job6Description: Improved UI, delivered features, and pair-programmed. Grew the product with senior mentorship.
index.job7Description: Built Angular components for internal systems and helped modernize legacy pieces.
